name: reh11_strike_roll
description: REH test 7. State 0's monthly strike check, schools then hospitals, on the class's generator. School 1 is in the can-strike group 0x1A03 with grade 0.4 -> p = strikeCurve(40) = 50; school 2 is not in the group and does not draw. The draw 49.9 < 50 starts a strike: the strike-day property 0xEAA69F83 := today (1234), the 'striking_education' controllers are added, and as the first change BeginStrike sets the city-level flag and start and posts 0x077ACCD0 with the occupant, data2 = 1, data3 = 0. Hospital 3 (group 0x1A02, grade 0.4) draws 50.0, not < 50: no strike. Exactly one RandomDoubleRangeUniform(0, 100) per eligible non-striking building; then the ordinance effects are re-read.
